label: Build a list
description: Build one list from wired values, one input port per item: `List(first: String, second: String)` gives `[first, second]`, in the order the ports are written. Every item is one type `T`, worked out from what is wired; items of different kinds need the list's type declared (`-> (list: List[Media])` holds an Image and a Video). Ports are required, so a closed branch skips the node; an item written `name?:` is left out when nothing arrives (no gap, no null).

outputs.name: list
outputs.description: The items in written order. Declare its type when the items are of different kinds: `-> (list: List[Media])`.

then.message: List '{id}' declares no input ports, so there are no items to build. Declare one port per item, `List(first: String, second: String)`, and wire each.
